query:
SELECT c.relname::text AS "name!" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'
            WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND NOT c.relispartition
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attname = 'workspace_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped)
